Search journal entries. Every filter is optional, and filters combine. `text` matches every word. Newest entries come first by default.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |
| `text` | `string` | no | Search words. Every word must match. |
| `kind` | `("done" \| "blocker" \| "next")[]` | no | Only entries of these kinds: done, blocker, or next. |
| `status` | `"open" \| "resolved"` | no | Only open or only resolved entries. |
| `source` | `"cli" \| "mcp" \| "migration"` | no | Only entries that came from this source. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Only entries from this date (inclusive): a local day or an ISO timestamp. |
| `to` | `string` | no | Only entries up to this date (inclusive): a local day or an ISO timestamp. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Most entries to return. The maximum is 500. Default: `50`. |
| `order` | `"asc" \| "desc"` | no | desc puts the newest entries first. asc puts the oldest first. Default: `"desc"`. |
| `includeDeleted` | `boolean` | no | Also return entries that you deleted. |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry list](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-list).

## Examples

Find done and next entries that match a word.

```json
{
  "text": "rounding",
  "kind": [
    "done",
    "next"
  ],
  "limit": 5
}
```

The text result:

```markdown
- 2026-11-15 16:04 `TXG3ZWS3` [billing-api] Add a regression test for tax rounding #testing #invoices (next, open)
- 2026-11-15 16:04 `YDZR73PK` [billing-api] Fix rounding error in invoice totals #bugfix #invoices
```

The structured result lists each entry with all of its fields. This example shows the first entry only.

```json
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "id": "01M7FRCQ9H56YJ9S1ATXG3ZWS3",
      "createdAt": "2026-11-15T14:04:47.281Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-11-15T14:04:47.281Z",
      "deletedAt": null,
      "deviceId": "01M7FRCQ7JDAH7AYES8A121Y7N",
      "summary": "Add a regression test for tax rounding",
      "details": null,
      "kind": "next",
      "status": "open",
      "resolvedAt": null,
      "resolvedByEntryId": null,
      "project": "billing-api",
      "repo": "acme/billing-api",
      "branch": "fix/invoice-rounding",
      "source": "mcp",
      "agent": null,
      "tags": [
        "testing",
        "invoices"
      ],
      "refs": []
    },
    "... 1 more"
  ],
  "count": 2
}
```
